meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 装上后,它会检查界面是否符合预期:先识别界面类型(网页、终端界面、分页文档),截图并用脚本算差异,再同时派两个只读检查员分头审核,最后给出通过、需修改或不通过的结论。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后,或被问到网页、组件或终端界面是否正确时使用;需对照设计稿,或怀疑回归、文字截断、布局溢出时也适用。没有可见界面时不用。

say.text: 我刚改完设置页,帮我做次界面视觉检查。
say.note: 会截图、对比差异,并派两个只读检查员审核。

say.text: 看看这个终端界面有没有布局溢出或边框错位。
say.note: 会走真实终端渲染并检测宽度。

say.text: 对照这张设计稿检查新页面,留意文字是否截断。
say.note: 参考图和实际截图会同时交给检查员。

howto.what_en: Claude verifies a rendered UI against intent: it identifies the surface (web, terminal, paginated), captures screenshots, runs script diffs, dispatches two parallel read-only reviewers, and gives a pass or revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Use after you build or change any UI, when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right, or when output must match a mock or baseline and regression, overflow, or clipped CJK text is suspected. Skip when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: I just changed the settings page; do a visual check of the UI
say_en.note: Captures screenshots, runs diffs, sends two reviewers

say_en.text: Check this terminal UI for overflowed layout or broken borders
say_en.note: Renders in a real terminal and runs width checks

say_en.text: Compare this new page against the design mock; watch for clipped text
say_en.note: Both reference and actual captures go to the reviewers
